citation: HL7 v2.6 Chapter 8, section 8.4.2 MFN/MFK - Master File Notification - General (Event M13), p 8-6; the same structure is printed for MFK^M01 (8.4.1), MFK^M02 (8.7.1), MFK^M03 (8.8.2), MFK^M08 (8.8.3), MFK^M09 (8.8.4), MFK^M10 (8.8.5), MFK^M11 (8.8.6), MFK^M12 (8.8.7), MFK^M05 (8.9.1), MFK^M04 (8.10.1), MFK^M06 (8.11.1), MFK^M07 (8.11.1), MFK^M15 (8.12.1), MFK^M16 (8.12.2) and MFK^M17 (8.13.1). Two normative prints of MFK_M01 disagree: Chapter 8 section 8.4.1 (MFK^M01^MFK_M01, p 8-5) prints no UAC (as does 8.8.2 MFK^M03), fourteen others print [UAC] after SFT (8.4.2 MFK^M13, p 8-6; 8.7.1 M02; 8.8.3 to 8.8.7 M08 to M12; 8.9.1 M05; 8.10.1 M04; 8.11.1 M06 and M07; 8.12.1 M15; 8.12.2 M16; 8.13.1 M17), which accepts every message the 8.4.1 print accepts; the looser 8.4.2 print is primary (P8b-9 ruling; register section E). HL7-xml v2.6/MFK_M01.xsd has the UAC.
